greeting.text: U-um... h-hello. I'm... G-Grey. Sorry. Sorry! I didn't mean to stand so close. We're not even touching. Sorry anyway.
A-ah! Someone's talking to me! I'm Grey. Of the Black Bulls. I... I turn into things. It helps me talk.
Hello! (deepens voice) I mean, hah! Hello! I am the great Grey! ...Sorry. I'm just Grey. Nice to meet you.
Y-you beat Lotus Whomalt? That's amazing! I'm Grey. I was too scared to come out until you did. Sorry.
You look tired. I c-could turn into a pillow! ...I'm joking. S-sorry. I'm Grey.

hint.text: Not every chest is a chest. Some have teeth. If it's sitting alone in a corner, be careful. ...Don't ask how I know.
If something looks too friendly, it might be a monster. Or me. ...It's usually a monster.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun is scary. They don't scare me as much as my family did. ...That's not comforting, is it? Sorry.
People with a third eye don't blink the same. I noticed that. ...I notice things when I'm hiding.
The three brothers... one is gravity, one is curses, one is space. I could turn into a rock, but a rock gets crushed too. Sorry.
Lucius... is the one at the end. I'll hide behind someone bigger. ...I'll be someone bigger. Then I'll hide.
Seven strong strangers... Merlin is scary. Diane is huge. I could turn into a giant, but she'd just step on me. ...Sorry for thinking about it.
Another dungeon... with a hearth. A family. I wish I had a family like that. ...Oh! I do. The Black Bulls. Sorry, I forgot.
Twenty fights?! I... I think I'm proud of you. Is that allowed? Sorry.
Magic Convert draws a circle in front of you for two seconds. Any enemy spell that touches it turns into your mana. I'm... very proud of that one. ...Sorry for being proud.
Transmutation: Iron Spikes turns the ground ahead into iron and thrusts it up in a line. Quagmire turns the ground into sand for five seconds, and everything sinks.
Grand Transmutation turns every blessing on the enemies around you into a curse, and you take the blessings. It's a bit mean. ...Sorry.
I can change what I look like, and sometimes what other things are. The first time, I turned into a very large man by accident. ...He was loud.
Mars... crystals. I turned a rock into a crystal once, but it was a bad crystal. Sorry.
You beat Vetto? He grew his arm back, right? I'd have run. I'm glad you didn't.
Zagred makes words true... I can change what things are, too. But I have to touch them. He doesn't. That's... unfair.
Lucius is finished? I can stop pretending to be a rock now? Oh! Sorry. That was private.
When I'm shy, I turn into someone braver. When I'm someone braver, I turn into someone shy. It doesn't make sense, I know.
Asta never laughs at me. He just shouts good job at everything. I... like it.
Noelle is so brave. I wish I could be brave like that. ...Oh, she gets embarrassed when I say that. Sorry.
Zora pranked me once. I turned into a statue so he couldn't find me. It worked for three days.
I like it here. Nobody asks me to be someone else. ...Which is funny, because that's my magic.
There's no easy healing down there, so rest in safe rooms and Landings. I hide in them. Sometimes for hours.
Relics come from vaults, pedestals and bosses, as far as I know. If someone offers you one for free... it's probably a me. Sorry!

farewell.text: Take care! (deep voice) And don't dawdle!
Thank you for talking to me. I... don't do that often.
